column1: At low magnification, non-papillary urothelial carcinoma may show solid or irregular infiltrative tumor architecture and broad sheets of malignant urothelial cells.
At low magnification, papillary urothelial carcinoma may show branching papillary fronds with stromal cores and complex or fused papillary structures.
At high magnification, non-papillary urothelial carcinoma may show cohesive nests of atypical urothelial cells and variation in tumor nuclear size.
At high magnification, papillary urothelial carcinoma may show atypical urothelium lining fibrovascular cores and variation in urothelial nuclear size.
